evidence.location: Complete reports/current.md (358 lines), sections 1-9, mechanism/scaling tables, worked allocation and evidence appendix; frozen original task and effective requirements.
evidence.basis: Performed a new complete evidence review in /root/independent_reviews_a, separate from the coordinator and all TTCEN producers/other full-report perspectives. Read the whole 73,345-character manuscript in bounded untruncated ranges, then checked consequential claims against the original sections listed below, visual original tables/figures and existing calculation inputs/code/output. Dates, versions, populations, denominator changes, oracle versus deployable information and training versus fixed-checkpoint inference are consistently qualified. Candidate coverage is not substituted for selected correctness, nor are generation counts substituted for total cost or wall time. Source inconsistencies and unresolved aggregate token scope are retained as limits instead of used as quantitative operating rules. The hypothetical allocation follows its stated independent-candidate, uniform-accepted and deterministic worker assumptions. No evidence defect requiring revision was found.

Read the complete source code without executing it and all retained outputs (12 budget rows and 12 deadline rows). reading_limits: Did not rerun model inference, statistical resampling, arithmetic scripts or software checks; checked retained code/results and displayed source mathematics.
Did not download and audit the released TTC003 dataset files; the report likewise describes article-level inventories.
The reported TTC007 70.5B total versus stored-thinking-token scope is not fully reconciled in the report and is explicitly excluded from a cost estimate.
Author handoff metadata included a claim that a prior U1 review passed; that claim was not used as evidence. No coordinator full evidence response or another active perspective was read.
